goal: Let external IPC mining clients inspect the memory footprint of transactions retained by block templates
Prevents unbounded node memory usage when evicted mempool transactions remain pinned in active templates
agreement: Broad support with substantive review and testing, but open design suggestions remain
Concept support for enabling memory limits on block templates (ryanofsky)
Verified on mainnet with Stratum v2 template provider for 20 hours (xyzconstant)
Verified commit ordering, locking, and ran tests (enirox001)
Suggests tracking weak_ptr handles instead of a per-transaction map, and adding tests (ismaelsadeeq)

categories.name: mining
why: P2 because it gives external clients visibility into non-mempool memory pinned by long-lived block templates
Unblocks memory management needed by Stratum v2 template providers to prevent unbounded node memory growth
